title: 共促全球道路运输向零排放转型（国际视点）

summary: 在德国汉诺威商用车展上，绿色智能转型成为焦点，电动化、氢能、自动驾驶和数字化技术受到关注。欧盟道路运输碳排放约30%来自重型车辆，零排放重卡新注册占比仅2.4%，欧洲制造商呼吁补齐基建与政策短板。中国重汽、奇瑞、开沃、福田、广汽领程等中企展
summary_en: At the IAA Transportation show in Hanover, Germany, green and intelligent transformation took center stage, with electrification, hydrogen energy, autonomous driving and digital technologies attracting attention. About 30 percent of EU road transport carbon emissions come from heavy-duty vehicles, while zero-emission heavy trucks account for only 2.4 percent of new registrations; European manufacturers are calling for infrastructure and policy shortcomings to be addressed. Chinese companies including Sinotruk, Chery, Skywell, Foton and GAC Lingcheng showcased their products.

title: 人权的温度，在普通人的生活里（环球走笔）
title_en: The warmth of human rights is in ordinary people's lives (Global Notes)
summary: 本文以常驻拉美中国记者的见闻为线索，结合在秘鲁利马举行的第三届中拉人权圆桌会，指出人权的温度体现在普通人的生活中。会上围绕多边主义与人权展开讨论，有议员表示人权多边治理应通过公共政策改善人民生活、维护人的尊严。文章列举中拉合作建设的港口、道
summary_en: Drawing on the observations of Chinese journalists stationed in Latin America, and on the third China-Latin America Human Rights Roundtable held in Lima, Peru, this article notes that the warmth of human rights is reflected in the lives of ordinary people. At the meeting, discussions centered on multilateralism and human rights, and some lawmakers said multilateral human rights governance should improve people's lives and uphold human dignity through public policies. The article cites ports, roads and other China-Latin America cooperation projects.

summary_en: Anhui Province continues to deepen international industrial exchanges and cooperation. title: 中美达成八点成果共识

summary_en: China and the US reached eight-point consensus: agree to build a China-US constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity; support each other in hosting the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and G20 Summit, with the two leaders intending to attend each other's meetings; agree Iran should fulfill its commitment not to develop nuclear weapons, and no country or institution may levy tolls on international waterways.

title: 丁薛祥会见哈萨克斯坦第一副总理纳利巴耶夫
title_en: Ding Xuexiang meets with Kazakh First Deputy Prime Minister Nalibayev
summary: 丁薛祥会见哈萨克斯坦第一副总理纳利巴耶夫。丁薛祥表示，中哈两国是山水相连、命运与共的好邻居、好朋友、好伙伴。今年7月，习近平主席同托卡耶夫总统举行会晤，为发展两国关系和深化务实合作指明了方向。作为中哈合作委员会双方主席，双方要全面落实两国元
summary_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets with Kazakhstan's First Deputy Prime Minister Nalibayev. Ding Xuexiang said that China and Kazakhstan are good neighbors, good friends and good partners linked by mountains and rivers and sharing a common future. In July this year, President Xi Jinping met with President Tokayev, charting the course for developing bilateral relations and deepening practical cooperation. As co-chairs of the China-Kazakhstan Cooperation Committee, the two sides should fully implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state.

title: 全国人大常委会副委员长丁仲礼率团访问韩国并出席中韩议会交流机制会议
title_en: NPC Standing Committee Vice Chairman Ding Zhongli leads a delegation to visit South Korea and attend the China-ROK parliamentary exchange mechanism meeting
summary: 9月21日至22日，全国人大常委会副委员长丁仲礼应韩国国会邀请率团访问韩国，会见韩国国会议长赵正湜，并与副议长南仁顺共同出席中韩议会交流机制第十四次会议。丁仲礼表示，当前国际形势纷繁复杂，中韩应坚守建交初心、坚定睦邻友好、坚持互利共赢，落实
summary_en: From September 21 to 22, Ding Zhongli, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, led a delegation to visit South Korea at the invitation of the South Korean National Assembly. He met with Speaker of the National Assembly Cho Jung-sik and, together with Deputy Speaker Nam In-soon, attended the 14th meeting of the China-South Korea parliamentary exchange mechanism. Ding Zhongli said that the current international situation is complex and volatile, and China and South Korea should adhere to the original aspiration of establishing diplomatic relations, uphold good-neighborliness and friendship, and pursue mutual benefit and win-win results, and implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries.

title_en: After 18 years of green development and innovation, the 18-year-old Sino-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City strides toward a new green future
summary: 中新天津生态城迎来开发建设18周年，昔日盐碱荒滩已变为“一座轻轻放进大自然的城”，并启动国家绿色发展示范区升级版建设。产业方面，聚焦绿色低碳、数字经济、生命健康、海洋文旅等主导产业，一汽丰田新能源工厂、中国资源循环集团总部、北方大数据交易中
summary_en: The China-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City marked the 18th anniversary of its development and construction. The once saline-alkali wasteland has become "a city gently placed in nature," and it has launched the upgraded construction of a national green development demonstration zone. In terms of industry, it focuses on leading sectors such as green and low-carbon, digital economy, life and health, and marine culture and tourism. Projects including the FAW Toyota new energy vehicle plant, the headquarters of China Resources Recycling Group, and the Northern Big Data Exchange Center have been introduced.

title: “现代化社区建设的典范”（共创繁荣发展新时代）
title_en: "A model of modern community building" (Jointly Create a New Era of Prosperity and Development)
summary: 北京建工承建的毛里求斯1200套社会保障房项目已全部竣工移交，是毛里求斯8000套保障房计划中首个且最大的建成交付项目，覆盖3个大区7座城市。项目通过优化建筑朝向与门窗布局、安装屋顶太阳能和雨水收集系统、修建蓄水坑渠等措施，实现自然通风降温
summary_en: The 1,200-unit social housing project in Mauritius built by Beijing Construction Engineering Group has been completed and handed over. It is the first and largest completed and delivered project under Mauritius' 8,000-unit social housing program, covering three regions and seven cities. By optimizing building orientation and door/window layout, installing rooftop solar and rainwater collection systems, and building water storage pits and channels, the project achieved natural ventilation and cooling.

title: “中华民族一家亲”图片展在莫斯科举行
title_en: "Chinese Nation, One Family" photo exhibition held in Moscow
summary: “中华民族一家亲”图片展在莫斯科举行，精选39张新华社摄影作品，生动展现中国各民族交融共生、团结发展的图景。中国驻俄罗斯大使张汉晖观展时表示，图片展描绘了各族人民互帮互助、和谐共处的景象，讲述民族团结奋进故事；《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促
summary_en: The photo exhibition "One Family of the Chinese Nation" was held in Moscow, featuring 39 selected Xinhua News Agency photographs vividly depicting the integration, coexistence and united development of all ethnic groups in China. While visiting the exhibition, Chinese Ambassador to Russia Zhang Hanhui said the photo exhibition portrays people of all ethnic groups helping each other and living in harmony, and tells stories of ethnic unity and progress; the Law of the People's Republic of China on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress was also highlighted.

title: 中国海军“吉祥方舟”号医院船抵达塞内加尔
title_en: Chinese Navy Hospital Ship 'Auspicious Ark' Arrives in Senegal
summary: 当地时间9月25日上午，执行“和谐使命—2026”任务的中国海军“吉祥方舟”号医院船抵达塞内加尔首都达喀尔，开始友好访问并提供医疗服务。这是中国海军医院船首次访问塞内加尔。访问期间，“吉祥方舟”号医院船利用主平台开展医疗服务，并派出医疗培训
summary_en: On the morning of Sept 25 local time, the Chinese Navy hospital ship 'Auspicious Ark' on the Mission Harmony-2026 arrived in Dakar, Senegal, for a friendly visit and to provide medical services. This is the first visit by a Chinese Navy hospital ship to Senegal. During the visit, the hospital ship used its main platform to provide medical services and sent medical training teams.

title: 韩正会见柬埔寨国王西哈莫尼和太后莫尼列

summary: 韩正会见柬埔寨国王西哈莫尼和太后莫尼列。韩正转达了习近平主席和夫人彭丽媛的亲切问候和良好祝愿，表示中柬铁杆友谊由两国老一辈领导人共同缔造和精心培育，历经风雨、坚如磐石。在两国领导人战略指引下，双边关系迈入构建新时代全天候中柬命运共同体的新阶
summary_en: Han Zheng Meets with Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Queen Mother Norodom Monineath. Han Zheng conveyed the cordial greetings and best wishes of President Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan, saying that the ironclad friendship between China and Cambodia was jointly forged and carefully nurtured by the older generation of leaders of the two countries and has withstood storms and remained rock-solid. Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, bilateral relations have entered a new stage of building a China-Cambodia community with a shared future in the new era.
